title: The Gilded Spire
author: Quentin Whitlock
blurb: Mirabel Halloran, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
